description: A five-panel composite figure of kernel-density-estimate (KDE) distribution plots, each comparing "Original Data" (solid blue line) with "Augmented Data" (dashed orange line) generated by GMM enhancement. All panels share the y-axis label "Density" and a light grey grid; only the x-axis variable differs. (a) "Distribution: Dislocation strengthening": x from -200 to 1000, y 0-0.0035; a sharp main peak near x≈50-100 (original slightly above 0.0030, augmented ≈0.0033) plus a small secondary bump near x≈800. (b) "Distribution: Fine grain strengthening": x -200 to 1000, y 0-0.0030, single main peak near x≈150 with a long right tail. (c) "Distribution: Solid solution strengthening": x -200 to about 850, y 0-0.005, main peak near x≈30-50 (original ≈0.0053, augmented ≈0.0049) with a shoulder near x≈270 and a minor bump near x≈750. (d) "Distribution: Orowan strengthening": x -200 to 1400, y 0-0.005, narrow peak near x≈50 and faint tails near x≈550 and 1100. (e) "Distribution: YS": x -500 to 3500, y 0-0.0010, main peak near x≈300-350 with a broad right tail. Every panel shows the augmented curve closely tracking the original, with the augmented peak slightly higher/narrower and identical truncation ranges — demonstrating that augmentation preserves each mechanism's distribution shape. No numeric values are printed on the panels; no axis units are given.

observations.observation: The figure is a five-panel composite of kernel density plots labelled (a)-(e), comparing solid blue 'Original Data' with dashed orange 'Augmented Data' curves in every panel.
Panel (a) is titled 'Distribution: Dislocation strengthening' with x-axis 'Dislocation strengthening' spanning roughly -200 to 1000 and y-axis 'Density' from 0 to 0.0035.
Panel (a) shows a dominant peak near x≈50-100 plus a small secondary bump near x≈800, and the augmented curve peaks slightly above the original.
Panel (b) 'Distribution: Fine grain strengthening' has y-axis 0-0.0030 and a single main peak near x≈150 with a long right tail.

Panel (c) 'Distribution: Solid solution strengthening' has the highest density scale of the group (y 0-0.005); the original solid curve peaks near x≈30-50 at roughly 0.0053, higher than the augmented dashed curve (~0.0049).
Panel (c) additionally shows a shoulder near x≈270 and a very small bump near x≈750.
Panel (d) 'Distribution: Orowan strengthening' spans x from -200 to 1400 with y 0-0.005 and shows a single narrow peak near x≈50.
Panel (e) is titled 'Distribution: YS' with y-axis 'Density' 0-0.0010 and x-axis 'YS' from -500 to 3500; the peak lies near x≈300-350 with a broad right tail.
The caption states the figure compares nuclear density distribution across the four strengthening mechanisms and YS: (a) Dislocation, (b) Fine grain, (c) Solid solution, (d) Orowan, (e) YS.
The citing text states the augmented data reproduce the core features of the original distributions and exhibit similar trends across all four reinforcement mechanisms and YS.
The citing text states the generated data for all reinforcement mechanism parameters strictly adhere to the explicit value range.

The citing text states the YS-generated data overlap the original peak and share identical right truncation points, which is not directly verifiable from printed numbers since no values are annotated on the panels.
No numeric values, axis units or sample compositions are printed on any of the five panels; only gridlines, tick labels and the two-entry legend are given.

subfigures.description: KDE plot 'Distribution: Dislocation strengthening'; x-axis 'Dislocation strengthening' about -200 to 1000, y-axis 'Density' 0-0.0035; solid blue 'Original Data' and dashed orange 'Augmented Data'. Main peak near x≈50-100 with a small secondary bump near x≈800; augmented curve peaks slightly higher (~0.0033 vs ~0.0030).

KDE plot 'Distribution: Fine grain strengthening'; x-axis 'Fine grain strengthening' about -200 to 1000, y-axis 'Density' 0-0.0030. Single main peak near x≈150 with a long right tail; augmented (dashed) curve peaks slightly higher (~0.0029 vs ~0.0026) and tracks the original closely.

KDE plot 'Distribution: Solid solution strengthening'; x-axis 'Solid solution strengthening' about -200 to 850, y-axis 'Density' 0-0.005. Original (solid) peak near x≈30-50 reaches ~0.0053 while the augmented peak is lower (~0.0049) and shifted slightly right, with a shoulder near x≈270 and a negligible bump near x≈750.

KDE plot 'Distribution: Orowan strengthening'; x-axis 'Orowan strengthening' about -200 to 1400, y-axis 'Density' 0-0.005. Narrow single peak near x≈50 with faint secondary bumps near x≈550 and x≈1100; augmented peak slightly higher than original.

KDE plot 'Distribution: YS'; x-axis 'YS' about -500 to 3500, y-axis 'Density' 0-0.0010. Main peak near x≈300-350 with a broad right tail out to ~2500; augmented (dashed) curve overlaps the original peak and shares the same truncation range.
